beethovenhaus.name: Beethoven-Haus
beethovenhaus.slogan: Start where the symphonies started: one attic room on Bonngasse.
beethovenhaus.line: Oh, they are not for you, but for a later age!
beethovenhaus.by: Beethoven, on his Razumovsky quartets, to violinist Felix Radicati

drachenfels.name: Drachenfels
drachenfels.slogan: 321 metres above the Rhine, and the view has fans since Byron.
drachenfels.line: The castled crag of Drachenfels / Frowns o'er the wide and winding Rhine.
drachenfels.by: Lord Byron, Childe Harold's Pilgrimage, Canto III, 1816

bonnermuenster.name: Bonn Minster
bonnermuenster.slogan: Romanesque towers over the graves of Bonn's two patron martyrs.
bonnermuenster.line: Its late Romanesque church was built between 1140 and 1250, on the site of the graves of the martyrs Cassius and Florentius.

drachenburg.name: Schloss Drachenburg
drachenburg.slogan: A neo-Gothic fairytale perched on the slope below the Drachenfels.
drachenburg.line: Banker Stephan von Sarter built it in 1882-1884 and planned to live there, but never did.

hausgeschichte.name: Haus der Geschichte
hausgeschichte.slogan: Post-war Germany, from rubble to reunion, under one roof.
hausgeschichte.line: Opened in 1994, it draws around one million visitors a year, among Germany's most popular museums.
